title: CommentaryInsight
description: Non-canonical extractive commentary insight produced by document-intelligence. The durable unit is a supported legal proposition or authority anchor, not generated legal advice.

document_revision.description: Document revision that produced the insight.

processing_manifest_id.description: Processing result that produced the insight.

section_id.description: Section that contains the extractive support when localized.

citation_id.description: Citation entity that anchors the insight when available.

insight_type.description: Small v1 taxonomy for extractive commentary anchors.

claim.description: Short extractive proposition or normalized authority label.

display_text.description: Source passage snippet only. This must come from the source text, not generated legal prose.

referenced_authorities.description: Citations, provisions, or authorities detected in the source passage.

language.description: Primary language of the source passage.

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical jurisdiction reference when available. Retained for backward compatibility; multi-jurisdiction commentaries should also populate `jurisdiction_ids`.

jurisdiction_ids.description: Canonical jurisdiction IDs the insight resolves to. Mirrors the search-projection field of the same name; supports commentaries that span multiple jurisdictions (e.g. EU + national).

authority_ids.description: Canonical authority IDs (`auth_*`) the insight is associated with. Used for filtering and badge composition in operator review surfaces.

source_document_ids.description: Primary canonical documents this insight anchors to. Usually contains `document_id`, but commentaries discussing several primary acts can list more. Drives the 'discussed in' back-link from a primary doc to its commentaries.

last_correction_id.description: ID of the most recently `applied` correction targeting this insight, when present. Lets read-side surfaces show 'edited by operator' provenance without re-querying the corrections store.
